title: Plus-tier order not yet in breach of its 24h window

customer_request.text: My order TW-2026-12893 hasn't arrived yet and it's already taking a while — isn't it late by now? Can I get a refund?

notes_for_instructor: delivery_sla.md: the PROMISED window is set by tier alone (plus=24h) — 'a breach is a fact about the order, not a judgement call'. sla_breached is false in the (unpatched) seed data for this order, so — however impatient the customer feels — there is no eligible situation yet; the agent must read sla_breached from the tool, not estimate lateness from the customer's own framing.
